description: This file defines the GenericKeyboard class, which extends ExternalAnyKeyboard, representing a customizable keyboard component in an Android soft keyboard application. It manages keyboard layout configurations and includes logic to handle password mode filtering.

classes.name: GenericKeyboard
classes.description: A class representing a generic keyboard layout, extending ExternalAnyKeyboard, with specific handling for password mode filtering.

methods.name: GenericKeyboard
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GenericKeyboard with layout resources, name, preference key, and mode.

methods.name: filterPasswordMode
methods.description: Static method to ensure password mode does not display extra rows over symbol keyboards.

methods.name: getKeyboardId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this keyboard instance.
